description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the Execution Accuracy of two different methods, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four distinct categories. The horizontal axis displays the categories, ordered from left to right as Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total, without an explicit axis label. The vertical axis is labeled "Execution Accuracy" and uses a linear scale with a visible range from 20 to 60, featuring tick marks at regular intervals of 10. The chart features grouped bars, with each category containing two adjacent bars. According to the legend positioned at the top, the lighter grey-blue bars represent NatSQL, while the darker blue bars represent TA-SQL. Within each group, the NatSQL bar is positioned on the left and the TA-SQL bar is on the right. Every bar is visually emphasized with an exact numerical annotation at its top. For the Simple category, NatSQL is 60.21 and TA-SQL is 63.14, which is the tallest bar in the chart. In the Moderate category, NatSQL is 39.64 and TA-SQL is 48.60. The Challenging category contains the shortest bar overall, with NatSQL at 32.32, alongside TA-SQL at 36.11. Finally, the Total category shows NatSQL at 51.35 and TA-SQL at 56.19. The categories are not sorted in strictly ascending or descending order by value, but across all four groups, the darker blue TA-SQL bars consistently display higher values than the corresponding lighter grey-blue NatSQL bars.
